examples.question_text:
Convert these lengths.
a. $6.83$ cm to millimetres
b. $927$ cm to metres
c. $0.048$ km to metres
examples.solution_text:
a. Millimetres are smaller than centimetres, so multiply by $10$.
$6.83\times10=68.3$
$6.83\text{ cm}=68.3\text{ mm}$
b. Metres are larger than centimetres, so divide by $100$.
$927\div100=9.27$
$927\text{ cm}=9.27\text{ m}$
c. Metres are smaller than kilometres, so multiply by $1000$.
$0.048\times1000=48$
$0.048\text{ km}=48\text{ m}$

Change kilometres to metres, then centimetres and millimetres.
$0.037\times1000=37$
$0.037\text{ km}=37\text{ m}$
$37\times100=3700$
$37\text{ m}=3700\text{ cm}$
$3700\times10=37000$
$3700\text{ cm}=37000\text{ mm}$
So $0.037\text{ km}=37000\text{ mm}$.

examples.question_text:
A piece of wood is $3.7$ m long. A length of $86$ cm is removed from one end.
How long is the piece of wood now? Give your answer in centimetres.
examples.solution_text:
Change metres to centimetres first.
$3.7\times100=370$
$3.7\text{ m}=370\text{ cm}$
$370-86=284$
The remaining length is $284\text{ cm}$.

examples.question_text:
Convert these lengths.
a. $2850$ m to kilometres
b. $3.6$ m to centimetres
c. $146$ mm to centimetres
d. $1.25$ m to millimetres
examples.solution_text:
a. Kilometres are larger than metres, so divide by $1000$.
$2850\div1000=2.85$
$2850\text{ m}=2.85\text{ km}$
b. Centimetres are smaller than metres, so multiply by $100$.
$3.6\times100=360$
$3.6\text{ m}=360\text{ cm}$
c. Centimetres are larger than millimetres, so divide by $10$.
$146\div10=14.6$
$146\text{ mm}=14.6\text{ cm}$
d. Change metres to centimetres, then millimetres.
$1.25\times100=125$
$1.25\text{ m}=125\text{ cm}$
$125\times10=1250$
$125\text{ cm}=1250\text{ mm}$
So $1.25\text{ m}=1250\text{ mm}$.
